policy: Track opportunities without automatically adding mechanics. Existing runtime, proposed-kit interactions and future ideas are separate. Shared wording does not create an alias or transfer private stacks.

mechanics.name: Burn
mechanics.summary: Ordinary Burn is a shared damage-over-time keyword. Shadowfire and owned Rosebrand do not automatically count as ordinary Burn.

mechanics.name: Poison
mechanics.summary: Ordinary Poison is separate from Toxin and Nyssara's private Venomweave stacks.

mechanics.name: Shields
mechanics.summary: Temporary HP shields can connect straightforward protection kits. Named guard charges such as Frostplate are not automatically HP shields.

mechanics.name: Shield breaking
mechanics.summary: Enemy damage breaking a shield can trigger recovery. Expiry, dispel and voluntary consumption are separate events.

mechanics.name: Healing
mechanics.summary: Direct healing, regeneration and life drain may have different trigger rules. Check which source and healing type an ability reads.

mechanics.name: Overheal
mechanics.summary: Healing beyond missing HP can reward a kit, without adding a new shared resource to every healer.

mechanics.name: Cleansing
mechanics.summary: Removing debuffs can support cleanse-triggered recovery. Own-caster and any-source triggers are different.

mechanics.name: Buff removal
mechanics.summary: Removing enemy buffs can enable anti-buff passives. Encounter-locked buffs are not assumed removable.

mechanics.name: Speed down
mechanics.summary: Ordinary Speed down can set up several heroes without requiring a private mark. Similar movement debuffs are not automatic aliases.

mechanics.name: Healing reduction
mechanics.summary: Anti-healing debuffs can supply another hero's damage condition. Use the strongest generic reduction, rather than adding copies.

mechanics.name: Boss break
mechanics.summary: Shared offensive Break is Basic 0 / Active 1 / Ultimate 2, plus 1 for elemental advantage, once per target per action. Boss capacities scale around 20–40+ by content. Reactions and pure support add none. A target with no gauge is not already Broken.

mechanics.name: Basic attacks
mechanics.summary: Basic-focused heroes can receive team support while still generating only their own explicitly defined resources.

mechanics.name: Ultimates
mechanics.summary: Ultimate-use triggers and charge gifts can create a team cadence. Triggered effects do not automatically refund charge.

mechanics.name: Critical hits
mechanics.summary: Crit buffs, reductions and conditional bonuses may interact; strongest generic buff rules still apply.

mechanics.name: Regeneration
mechanics.summary: Recurring healing is not a direct heal for every passive. Keep its trigger identity explicit.

mechanics.name: Buffs
mechanics.summary: Straightforward team buffs and enemy-buff conditions can form useful teams without new stack systems.

mechanics.name: Burn
mechanics.summary: A nonstacking damage-over-time status. It ticks directly against HP on its bearer's turn, bypassing shields. Consumers check the burn key regardless of the source. Shadowfire does not qualify; refreshes keep higher power and duration.

mechanics.name: Shadowfire
mechanics.summary: Veyra Dusk's separate damage-over-time status, usually 2 turns or 3 from her Ultimate. It can coexist with Burn, with separate power. It ticks directly against HP but does not activate code that specifically checks Burn.

mechanics.name: Chill
mechanics.summary: Reduces effective Speed by its stored power, currently 22% from Yselle. Her Winterstep Requiem gains 28% damage against Chill and consumes it. Rimebound Oath also benefits before consumption; Chill is distinct from Frostplate.

mechanics.name: Exposed
mechanics.summary: Targets take 12% more ordinary direct damage. Mark and Pierce apply it; a friendly boss break can expose other enemies. Nemea benefits from any source, and No-Witness Step consumes it for another 25% damage.

mechanics.name: Weakened
mechanics.summary: Reduces outgoing ordinary direct damage by 18% from Veloura or 15% from Caelia. Dreamfed Covenant benefits from any Weakened target. Legacy effects named charm and charm_aoe apply this debuff; they do not redirect attacks or deny actions.

mechanics.name: Tethered
mechanics.summary: Veyra Dusk lowers effective Speed by 22% for 2 turns with Tethering Coil, or 18% for 3 turns with Nightfall Scourge. This is a slow, not an action-denying bind.

mechanics.name: Poison
mechanics.summary: Aveline's one nonstacking Poison stores power equal to 18% of her ATK and ticks directly against HP. Bitter Eden deals 25% more direct damage to a target already carrying Poison. The separate Toxin status does not satisfy that check.

mechanics.name: Toxin
mechanics.summary: Nerisse's separate damage-over-time status caps at 3 stacks, with stored power based on 8% of her ATK per stack. Skills add and spread it; her Ultimate consumes pre-cast stacks for extra damage, then applies a fresh stack. Poison does not count.

mechanics.name: Corroded
mechanics.summary: Targets take 15% more ordinary direct and concept-reaction damage and lose 10 Effect Resistance. Nerisse applies it to pre-Toxined targets with Measured in Threes, or to survivors when her Ultimate consumes 3 pre-cast stacks.

mechanics.name: Calcified
mechanics.summary: Thessa's 2-turn setup debuff lowers Speed by 8% and Effect Resistance by 10. She gains 20 Effect Accuracy against Calcified targets; her Petrify skills use higher base chances. Successful Petrify removes Calcified; resistance leaves it intact.

mechanics.name: Petrify / Petrified
mechanics.summary: Ordinary targets lose their next action and have 25% incoming direct-damage reduction while Petrified. An unbroken boss instead loses 35 action gauge and gains Quarried for 2 turns. Successful application consumes Calcified.

mechanics.name: Quarried
mechanics.summary: The current unbroken-boss substitute for Petrify lowers Speed by 15% for 2 turns after 35 action-gauge loss. It is distinct from Calcified and does not inherit its Resistance penalty.

mechanics.name: Root
mechanics.summary: Aveline's Root skips the next action of an ordinary target. An unbroken boss instead loses 30 action gauge. These are current runtime rules; the new review proposals retain their own explicitly written boss substitutes.

mechanics.name: Provoke / Provoked
mechanics.summary: Caelia applies 2-turn source-linked Provoke. Default target selection resolves the living opposing source; area skills still strike their normal group. This is not Charm and does not force use of Basic.

mechanics.name: Clearwater
mechanics.summary: Maelin grants 25 Effect Resistance for 2 turns with Pearl-Rinse, or 30 with Stillwater Absolution. This improves resistance to checked debuffs rather than granting guaranteed immunity.

mechanics.name: Diluted
mechanics.summary: Maelin's 2-turn debuff lowers the affected actor's Effect Accuracy by 12. It changes checked hostile-status reliability, not attack damage or Hit Rate.

mechanics.name: Hartbound
mechanics.summary: Maelis gains a 3-turn self buff that gives 12 Crit chance and enables later Spirit Arrows. Her Ultimate can extend it by 2 turns, capped at 4; natural expiry gives 12 action gauge while Wayhart's Instinct is present.

mechanics.name: Spirit Arrow
mechanics.summary: If Maelis had Hartbound before her action, she follows up against its surviving primary target: power 42 normally, 90 after her Ultimate, increased 15% against a boss. This separate reaction does not use normal hit, crit, charge or break processing.

mechanics.name: Temper
mechanics.summary: Adela's resource caps at 3 stacks, each reducing incoming direct damage by 4%. She starts at 1 and gains it when each ally first falls below half HP and after intercepting a hit. Thermal Screen consumes stacks to strengthen team protection.

mechanics.name: Covering Line
mechanics.summary: Adela's 2-turn stance intercepts an enemy's eligible single-target attack aimed at another hero, once per enemy action. The intercepted hit deals 28% less damage; she gains Temper and counters the living attacker with power 60. Redirect is specifically coded for allied Adela.

mechanics.name: Screened
mechanics.summary: Adela's 2-turn team direct-damage reduction. Thermal Screen consumes Temper for 10% plus 3% per stack, capped at 19%; her Ultimate supplies 18%. Separate reduction systems multiply, subject to the combat damage floor.

mechanics.name: Conductive
mechanics.summary: Zahra builds up to 3 stacks for 3 turns. They improve her Crit chance and lightning skills. Forked Decree uses pre-cast stacks for extra targets; Golden Deluge consumes total pre-cast stacks for capped arcs. Conductive does no tick damage itself.

mechanics.name: Frostplate
mechanics.summary: Protective charges cap at 3 per ally. The first direct hostile hit of an action against that ally consumes one to reduce that hit by 16%. Consumption can heal living Sivra and trigger Breakwater. This is separate from Chill and from the Shield value.

mechanics.name: Breakwater
mechanics.summary: Sivra's 2-turn Ultimate stance. When an enemy action consumes an allied Frostplate, she counterwaves all living enemies with power 42, once per enemy action. The trigger finds a living Sivra with the stance, without requiring her to own the original plate.

mechanics.name: Verdant Chorus
mechanics.summary: Jianne grants 3-turn ordinary direct-damage and effective-Speed buffs: 14% with First Chord, 16% with Canopy Chorus, 18% with Sevenfold Spring. Stored DoT ticks and concept-reaction damage do not read this buff. Same-key refresh keeps stronger power and duration.

mechanics.name: Barrier / Shield
mechanics.summary: The shared Shield value absorbs ordinary direct and concept-reaction damage before HP. Runtime shields have no duration; granting methods either keep the stronger value or add an amount. DoT ticks bypass shields. The review proposals separately define their 2-turn shield rules.

mechanics.name: Cleanse
mechanics.summary: Ordinary action healing removes all harmful statuses except Broken. Maelin's dedicated skills instead have explicit limits: two on one ally, one on each ally, or all on each ally. Her limited cleanses prioritize control before damage-over-time statuses.

mechanics.name: Break / Broken
mechanics.summary: Successful offensive Basics deal 0 Break, Actives 1 and Ultimates 2; elemental advantage adds 1, once per target per chosen action. Multi-hit components, reactions, DoTs and pure support add none. Boss capacities scale by content: normal Campaign 20–40, Hard 28–48, Tower 24–48, Event 32, Raid 48, Labyrinth 20–56 by depth/difficulty. At zero, 2-turn Broken increases ordinary direct damage by 28%; friendly breaks add 28 Party Burst and may Expose other enemies. Gauge refills on expiry.

mechanics.name: Party Burst
mechanics.summary: A shared meter caps at 100. Friendly hits, misses, breaks and Ultimates build it; the next friendly non-Basic action at full meter consumes it for 32% more action scale, affecting supported damage or healing. Ink Bloom adds 18 at battle start.

mechanics.name: Type Domain
mechanics.summary: Every Ultimate sets the active Domain to its skill type for 5 global acting-unit turns from a hero, or 3 from an enemy. Matching skills gain 10% action scale for heroes or 5% for enemies. Another Ultimate replaces the Domain.

mechanics.name: Ultimate Charge
mechanics.summary: Ultimates require and spend 100 charge. Basics give 18, Actives 26, once per action; direct damage taken or shield absorption can add charge. Specific passives and Maelin's cleanse skills add bonuses. Charge caps at 100.

mechanics.name: Action Gauge
mechanics.summary: A persistent Speed-based scheduler builds the action queue from gauge. Opening passives and specific triggers add it; Root and Petrify boss substitutes remove it. A gauge change is not a separate immediate extra-turn API.

mechanics.name: Drain
mechanics.summary: Veloura's Dreamdrinker restores a fixed 18% of her own Max HP after attacking if she remains alive. Current runtime drain is not a fraction of damage dealt and does not require Weakened.

mechanics.name: Guard / Brace
mechanics.summary: The generic Vanguard Guard attack deals reduced damage, heals using half the caster's DEF, and adds a DEF-sized Shield up to half the caster's Max HP. It is self-protection rather than an allied intercept or formal counter stance.

mechanics.name: Revive Heal
mechanics.summary: The original Support Ultimate revives one fallen ally at 25% Max HP, then heals living allies and cleanses harmful statuses except Broken. This older-roster behavior does not grant resurrection to the new review proposals.

mechanics.name: DEF Pierce
mechanics.summary: Generic Pierce lowers the DEF contribution and can apply Exposed. Maelis's Thread the Briar uses a multiplier equivalent to ignoring 35% of the ordinary DEF contribution. This is not an ongoing team DEF-down debuff.

mechanics.name: Low-HP Execute Bonus
mechanics.summary: Nemea's Violet Null deals 45% more damage if the target is at or below 50% HP before damage. It does not instantly kill or bypass shields; the name does not imply an execution threshold.

mechanics.name: Lantern Without End
mechanics.summary: Veyra Wick gains 4 action gauge and 2 Ultimate charge when she applies, copies, extends or refreshes Burn, once per target per action. Her skills can read another hero's Burn. Shadowfire is not accepted.

mechanics.name: Aerie Supremacy
mechanics.summary: Soryn Caldris gains 4% direct damage per extra living enemy beyond the first, up to 16%. Her own Burn applications gain 10% tick power. This runtime dragon heroine is distinct from the accepted fox candidate Soryn Veilglass.

mechanics.name: Wyrmheart Resonance
mechanics.summary: Cerys gains 10% ATK at battle start. Her normal Burn skill applications gain 20% power and 1 extra turn. This strengthens her applications rather than globally multiplying an ally's existing Burn.

mechanics.name: Duskbound Coil
mechanics.summary: Veyra Dusk gains 8% Speed at battle start and her Shadowfire applications gain 20% power. It neither strengthens Veyra Wick's Burn nor enables Burn-only consumers.

mechanics.name: Dreamfed Covenant
mechanics.summary: Veloura gains 14 Effect Accuracy and deals 14% more ordinary direct damage to any Weakened enemy. The consumer checks the status key, so Caelia's Weakened enables it too.

mechanics.name: Rimebound Oath
mechanics.summary: Yselle gains 10 Crit chance and deals 16% more ordinary direct damage to any Chilled target. This works alongside her 28% Winterstep shatter bonus before that skill consumes Chill.

mechanics.name: Closed Case
mechanics.summary: Nemea starts with 16 extra action gauge and deals 16% more ordinary direct damage to any Exposed enemy. Other heroes' Pierce or Party Break can provide setup; her No-Witness Step consumes it.

mechanics.name: Quarantine Doctrine
mechanics.summary: Aveline gains 18 Effect Accuracy. Successfully applying Poison to a not-yet-Poisoned enemy gives 5 action gauge, once per target per action. Refreshing existing Poison does not give the new-Poison bonus.

mechanics.name: Weight Before Silence
mechanics.summary: Thessa gains 20 Effect Accuracy against Calcified enemies. A resisted Calcified or Petrify application gives her 8 action gauge, once per target per action; success does not give that refund.

mechanics.name: Nothing Worth Saving Is Lost
mechanics.summary: Maelin's dedicated heal resolver gives a cleansed ally an extra 3% Max HP heal and Maelin 3 Ultimate charge, once per ally actually cleansed per action. Another hero's heal/cleanse does not call her bonus resolver.

mechanics.name: Storm Seeks Ground
mechanics.summary: Zahra gains 10 Crit chance against Conductive enemies. Applying Conductive gives 2 action gauge once per target per action, capped at 10 over up to five targets. Her application gives gauge; the target's status enables Crit chance.

mechanics.name: White Strait Vigil
mechanics.summary: Sivra gives every ally a Frostplate at battle start. When the first direct hit of an enemy action consumes an ally's plate, living Sivra heals for 1.5% of her Max HP, once per affected ally for that action.

mechanics.name: The Gate Stays Open
mechanics.summary: Caelia grants all allies a starting Shield worth 6% of her Max HP. Having any Shield gives Caelia 15 Effect Resistance; the runtime condition accepts shields from teammates too.

mechanics.name: Life Engine
mechanics.summary: At battle start, Iori increases every ally's DEF and Healing Received by 10%. These are direct battle-start stat changes rather than temporary cleanseable status entries.

mechanics.name: Living Refrain
mechanics.summary: Jianne increases every ally's Speed and Healing Received by 8% at battle start. Her separate Verdant Chorus can add temporary direct-damage and effective-Speed support.

mechanics.name: Nova Relay
mechanics.summary: Astra gives all allies 12 Ultimate charge and 12 action gauge at battle start, respecting their caps. This is opening support rather than a repeatable meter engine.

mechanics.name: Ink Bloom
mechanics.summary: Tamsin starts battle with 18 Party Burst and gives all allies 8 Effect Accuracy. This helps checked debuffs but does not automatically apply a status.

mechanics.name: Panic Tax
mechanics.summary: Rhea reduces each starting enemy's Speed by 12% and Effect Resistance by 15. These are direct stat changes, not named slow statuses that activate status-key consumers.

mechanics.name: Wide Fuse
mechanics.summary: Dax deals 14% more damage with Actives and his Ultimate. Basics do not receive the bonus; there are no stacks or team triggers.

mechanics.name: Blue Renewal
mechanics.summary: At Luna's turn start, heal the lowest-HP living ally for 6% of its Max HP, modified by Healing Received. It does not call the action-heal resolver, so this Passive heal does not cleanse.

mechanics.name: Molten Stand
mechanics.summary: Brann starts with an 18% Max HP shield and 18 Effect Resistance. It gives opening durability without a repeated shield-break trigger or counter.

mechanics.name: Shatter Cover
mechanics.summary: Kael starts with 16% more DEF and a shield equal to 12% of his Max HP. Despite the name, the passive does not consume Chill or trigger a shatter attack.

mechanics.name: Blackout
mechanics.summary: Mika gains 14 Crit chance, 14 Crit Damage and 10 action gauge at battle start. There is no stealth or darkness status in this passive.

mechanics.name: Dawn Pierce
mechanics.summary: Nyx gains 15 Crit chance and 25 Crit Damage at battle start. The passive itself does not apply Exposed or grant the generic Pierce skill effect.

mechanics.name: Battle Instinct
mechanics.summary: The reusable fallback passive grants 8% ATK and DEF at battle start. The default named heroes override it with their own named passives.

mechanics.name: Backdraft
mechanics.summary: Sevrin gains 12% ATK and 20 Effect Accuracy at battle start. This helps his checked Pierce-to-Exposed application but does not apply Burn despite its fire-themed name.

mechanics.name: Shelter
mechanics.summary: Selene gives every ally a starting Shield equal to 10% of the recipient's Max HP. This shares the Shield value with other barriers and supports Caelia's shielded Resistance condition.

mechanics.name: Elasticity
mechanics.summary: Roselle alone starts each wave with 1 Elasticity, maximum 4. Reservoir Body grants 1 after an enemy action deals direct HP or shield damage to her, once per enemy action regardless of hits; DoTs and friendly damage do not grant stacks. Cushion Court and Grand Embrace may spend them as specified. Stacks have no turn expiry and clear at wave end. Only Reservoir Body enables this resource; importing spenders does not create it. Auto spends the maximum available up to the skill's stated limit; manual play may spend less where the skill says up to.

mechanics.name: Shield consumption
mechanics.summary: Scatter the Facets and Crown in a Thousand Drops may spend only Roselle-applied shields currently on Roselle. Auto spends the maximum stated amount; manual play may decline. Spend oldest shields first up to the listed fraction of Roselle's Max HP. Partial shields keep their expiry. Consuming a shield never counts as enemy damage or shield break, and never triggers a heal, reaction or charge. The base attacks work without a shield. All shield amounts use Roselle's Max HP.

mechanics.name: Focus
mechanics.summary: Liora alone starts each wave with 0 Focus, maximum 3. Patient Hunter grants 1 after she resolves a Basic or a skill in Active1, once per action even if no damage lands; triggered actions do not grant it. Needle Horizon spends up to 2 and Thousand-Leaf Line up to 3 before damage. No turn expiry; clear at wave end. Patient Hunter alone enables Focus, including when other Basic or Active1 choices are imported. Auto spends the maximum available up to the skill's stated limit; manual play may spend less where the skill says up to.

mechanics.name: Trailmark
mechanics.summary: Enemies begin each wave without Liora's Trailmark. Chart the Quarry and One Road Through attempt one nonstacking mark for 2 target turns, checked once per target per action; refresh duration on reapplication. Ordinary allied direct action attacks against that target gain 10 percentage points of Crit chance for that action, using the strongest generic Crit-chance increase instead of adding it to another such buff. Only that marked target receives the contextual bonus, including during AoE. The mark is removable, clears on target or Liora defeat, expiry or wave end, and has no reaction damage. Surveyor's Eye can add an 8% direct-damage bonus against an already marked enemy, once per acting ally and at most three allied actions total per Liora turn. Its allowances begin available at wave entry and reset at the start of Liora's turns; the mark's Crit bonus works without the passive. This Liora owns at most one marked enemy: a successful new placement replaces her old mark; a resisted placement preserves it. Per-ally and total trigger allowances are shared across mark replacements and never reset by re-marking.

mechanics.name: Broodlets
mechanics.summary: Nyssara alone starts each wave with 2 Broodlets, cap 4. Silk Nursery grants 1 at the start of each of her turns, including her first turn of a wave. They are a resource counter, not targetable summons, and never receive independent actions. Carapace Shelter may spend up to 2, Matron's Rebuke 1, and Silken Citadel up to 4; no turn expiry, clear at wave end. Only Silk Nursery enables this resource. Auto spends the maximum available up to the skill's stated limit; manual play may spend less where the skill says up to.

mechanics.name: Venomweave
mechanics.summary: Each enemy starts at 0 Nyssara-owned Venomweave stacks, maximum 3. Venom Canticle attempts to add 1 after her ordinary Basic or Active1 deals direct damage, once per affected enemy per action with one Accuracy/Resistance check. A successful addition refreshes all her stacks there to 2 target turns. At the start of each of those turns, every stack deals noncritical Umbra damage equal to 18% of Nyssara's current ATK before normal mitigation. One cleanse removes one oldest stack. Venom Press may consume 1 before damage. Stacks vanish on expiry, defeat or wave end. Only Venom Canticle enables the resource; other sources of Poison do not count.

mechanics.name: Foxfire
mechanics.summary: Soryn alone starts each wave with 0 Foxfire, cap 3. Dawnkindled grants 1 after she resolves an ordinary Basic or Active1, once per action, including imported skills in those slots. Threefold Gleam and Dawn's Foxfire spend up to 3 before damage for their stated bonuses. Stacks have no turn expiry and clear at wave end. Only Dawnkindled enables this resource. Auto spends the maximum available up to the skill's stated limit; manual play may spend less where the skill says up to.

mechanics.name: Spirit Oath
mechanics.summary: Soryn begins each wave with no Spirit Oath holder. Foxfire Covenant places one Spirit Oath on a living ally for 2 of that ally's subsequent turns. Soryn can own only one oath: a new placement removes the previous one. Its holder gains 15% ATK, using the strongest generic ATK buff rather than adding them. The oath can be dispelled and clears on expiry, holder or Soryn defeat, or wave end. Oathkeeper's Answer can heal after that holder's Basic once per Soryn turn. Lantern Touch may read the holder; neither skill creates an oath. Quiet Procession no longer places one.

mechanics.name: Cinders
mechanics.summary: Seressa starts each wave at 0 Cinders, maximum 3. Banked Cinders enables the resource. After a non-Ultimate action of hers successfully applies Burn to at least one enemy, gain 1 Cinder, at most once per action. Cinders have no turn expiry; they clear on her defeat or a wave transition. Furnace Decree may spend 2; Crown of Ash spends all before dealing damage. Spenders never generate Cinders by themselves. Without Banked Cinders, mixed skills have 0 Cinders and keep their base effects.

mechanics.name: Startrace
mechanics.summary: Start each wave with no Startrace. Astral Survey enables this owned mark. After Orivelle finishes a hostile Active1 or Active2, mark its living primary enemy; an area action's primary is the enemy with highest current HP at action start. At most 1 enemy can carry her Startrace; a successful new mark removes the previous mark. Application checks Accuracy versus Resistance. It lasts 2 marked-enemy turns, refreshes without stacking, and is dispellable. It clears on Orivelle's defeat, target defeat, or a wave change. Falling Horizon consumes it after damage; other skills only read it. Friendly support Actives do not mark. Without Astral Survey, mixed skills keep their base effects but never create Startrace.

mechanics.name: Thorn Vow
mechanics.summary: Start with no Vow. Thornbound Promise enables it and attempts to mark the highest-ATK enemy at wave entry. After Elowyn finishes a hostile Active1 or Active2, it attempts to mark that action's living primary enemy. At most 1 enemy carries her Vow, for 2 marked-enemy turns; one successful new mark replaces the old one. Application checks Accuracy versus Resistance; refreshes do not stack. An area import's primary is highest current HP at action start. It is dispellable and clears on Elowyn's defeat, target defeat, or wave change. Last Rose consumes it after damage. Without Thornbound Promise, Vow never exists; other skills retain base effects.

mechanics.name: Bloom Reserve
mechanics.summary: Overflow Kept enables a personal resource, starting at 0 each wave, maximum 3. After one of Elowyn's own non-Ultimate ordinary actions directly heals at least one ally with at least 1% of that recipient's Max HP lost to overheal, gain 1 Bloom, maximum once per whole action. Regeneration, life drain, other triggered heals never qualify. Overheal is measured after healing modifiers but before discarding excess; damage and shields cannot generate Blooms. Blooms have no turn expiry and clear on Elowyn's defeat or a wave transition. Celebrate the Surplus spends 2 at action start if available; Roses in Reserve spends all at action start. Spent Blooms cannot be generated retroactively. Without Overflow Kept, mixed skills have 0 Blooms and keep their base effects.

mechanics.name: Barbed Accord
mechanics.summary: A dispellable Miravelle-owned enemy mark, maximum 1. Start each wave with no mark. Sign in Thorns attempts it for 2 target turns; The Devil's Terms attempts it for 3. A successful new application replaces her old mark; a resisted one leaves the old mark intact. After its bearer finishes its own ordinary Active1 or Active2 action while Miravelle is alive, deal 40% of Miravelle's ATK to that living bearer, at most once per bearer turn. Basics, Passives, Ultimates, denied/skipped actions, counters and follow-ups do not trigger it. Damage cannot crit, grant charge, inflict break or trigger any reactions. If either owner or bearer dies before the trigger, no damage occurs. The mark expires at the end of its stated subsequent bearer turns and clears on owner defeat, bearer defeat or wave transition; no independent turns or action delay.

mechanics.name: Facets
mechanics.summary: Enabled only by Perfect Fracture. Start at zero, cap four, persist until spent or the wave ends. Gain one after completing a Basic or Active action that dealt direct damage to at least one enemy alive immediately before its hit, including a killing blow, once per action and after all spending. Ultimates, counters, follow-ups and damage over time grant none. Needle Through Stone may spend up to two; Splinterstorm may spend one; Crownfall Fracture spends all. Auto spends the maximum allowed on each selected spender. The resource is personal, cannot transfer and clears between waves or on defeat.

mechanics.name: Icebound Reprisal
mechanics.summary: Applied only by Seal of the Quiet Lake or The Long Cold Answer after their direct damage, through one normal hostile accuracy/resistance check on a living enemy. Start with no mark. This Isavelle owns at most one marked enemy; a successful new mark replaces the old one, while a resisted application leaves the old mark. Cap one per enemy from this Isavelle; duration two marked-target turns, refreshed by reapplication. When the marked enemy's next direct hostile action deals positive damage to any allied HP or shield, including a killing blow, consume the mark after the whole action and retaliate once at that enemy for 60% of Isavelle's ATK snapshotted on mark application. Both Isavelle and the attacker must still be alive after that action; otherwise the mark clears without retaliation. A shield-only hit qualifies; misses, fully prevented damage, damage over time and reactions do not. Retaliation cannot crit, grant charge or trigger any reaction. A mark that expires unused deals no damage. It clears on either unit's defeat or wave transition; duplicate marks never multiply a single Isavelle's trigger.

mechanics.name: Crests
mechanics.summary: Enabled only by Reforming Current. Start at zero, cap three. Completing Nerielle's own Basic action grants one Crest once, even if its damage is absorbed; actives, Ultimates and reactions grant none. Persist until spent, defeat or wave end. At the start of each own turn with at least one Crest, heal self for 4% of own Max HP without consuming a Crest; no more than once per own turn. Compressed Torrent and Curling Bastion each spend one if available; Falling Ocean spends all, up to three. Auto spends the maximum allowed on the chosen spender. Personal, nontransferable, reset between waves.

mechanics.name: Waterbound Link
mechanics.summary: Applied by Tributary Bond or One Sea Between Us to one other living ally, without a hostile check. Start with no link. Nerielle owns at most one linked ally and cannot link herself; a new link replaces the old, refreshes for two linked-recipient turns, and never stacks with another Waterbound Link. When a direct enemy action would damage that ally's HP after the ally's shields and reductions, transfer 20% of that post-shield HP damage to Nerielle, limited to a total of 8% of Nerielle's Max HP across the entire enemy action, including all hits. Further damage stays on the ally. Transfer cannot be shielded or reduced again and is limited to Nerielle's current HP minus one; any untransferable amount remains with the ally. Thus it never kills Nerielle by itself or makes the ally immune. Transfer is neither an attack nor damage over time and cannot crit, grant charge or trigger any damage reaction or resource gain, except the single bounded end-of-action heal explicitly granted by A Body That Reforms. Shield-only damage creates no transfer. Check each hit while both units live; killing blows may be reduced but any excess can still defeat the linked ally. The link clears on either unit's defeat or wave transition. The cap resets for each direct enemy action, never per hit.

mechanics.name: Rally Point
mechanics.summary: Applied by Set the Line or Crimson Standard after their damage through the normal hostile accuracy check. Start with no mark. This Valdra owns at most one marked enemy; a successful new application removes her previous mark, while a failed application leaves it untouched. Duration two marked-target turns, refresh on reapplication, expire on target defeat, Valdra defeat or wave end. Allies' direct action damage to that target is increased by 8% multiplicatively. Only one Rally Point damage bonus may apply across duplicate Valdras. Reactions and damage over time do not benefit. Steady Orders may add a charge reward but is not required for the mark's damage effect.

mechanics.name: Rosebrand
mechanics.summary: Applied by Kindling Point, Searing Rose Thrust or Field of Embers after direct damage through one normal hostile accuracy/resistance check per surviving target. Start with no brands. This Valdra can own one Rosebrand per enemy, with no stack count. It burns for its listed 20% or 30% of Valdra's ATK, snapshotted on application, at the START of each of the target's next two turns; expiry is at the END of its second subsequent turn. Reapplication refreshes to two target turns and uses the higher remaining or new tick damage, never adds tick damage or duration; it cannot trigger an immediate tick. These are owned burns: multiple Valdras' Rosebrands on a target use only the strongest tick and do not produce simultaneous stacks, though each caster can consume only her own. Burn cannot crit, grant charge or trigger reactions. Lance Through Ash may consume the whole owned brand before damage to add at most two unticked scheduled ticks, capped at 60% of Valdra's current ATK in total. A tick already dealt is never included. Brand removal, target defeat, Valdra defeat or wave transition clears any remaining ticks without damage; a killing application places no brand.

mechanics.name: Shared shield conversion
mechanics.summary: For this proposal, distinct named HP shields on Roselle retain separate source/expiry layers and their remaining amounts form her shield pool. Reapplying the same named shield keeps the larger remaining/new amount; it does not add another layer. Each layer lasts its stated recipient turns. The Ultimate may consume any source's HP shield layers on Roselle only, up to 70% of her Max HP, and converts half into bonus damage per enemy capped at 35% Max HP. Consumption never triggers shield-break healing. Existing runtime uses one non-stacking Shield value; source-layer storage and consumption remain proposed implementation work.

mechanics.name: Erosion
mechanics.summary: An enemy can hold up to 3 Roselle-owned Erosion stacks, initially 0. Velvet Dissolution attempts to add 1 stack after each Roselle action dealing direct damage, once per affected enemy per action, with one Accuracy/Resistance check per enemy. A successful addition refreshes all her stacks on that enemy to at least 2 of its subsequent turns, preserving any longer remaining duration up to 3 turns. At the start of those turns each stack deals noncritical Tide damage equal to 12% of Roselle's current ATK before normal mitigation. Only the owning passive enables stacks. Slimeflow may extend remaining duration to at most 3 turns; Crownless Undertow can consume them. Expiry, cleansing, target defeat or wave end removes them; one cleanse removes one stack, oldest first.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Threadbound
mechanics.summary: Each enemy starts with no Nyssara-owned Threadbound mark. Binding Weave and Grand Lattice each attempt to apply 1 nonstacking mark for 2 of the target's subsequent turns, with one Accuracy/Resistance check per target per action. Reapplication refreshes duration; cleansing, defeat, expiry or wave end removes it. The mark alone does not reduce stats or deny actions. Listening Threads reacts after a marked enemy completes an ordinary action, subject to that passive's limits; denied turns, triggered actions and DoT ticks do not qualify. Cut the Supporting Thread can read the mark without that passive.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Frayed Contract
mechanics.summary: Enemies start with no Nyssara-owned Frayed Contract. Inkless Bargain attempts one nonstacking mark for 2 target turns, with one Accuracy/Resistance check; reapplication refreshes duration. The mark itself changes no stats. While Contract's Due is selected and Nyssara is alive, it can react after an ordinary enemy action applies or refreshes at least one removable buff on a living marked enemy, including self-buffs. One recipient qualifies only once per action, one reaction per marked recipient and two reactions total between starts of Nyssara's turns; allowances start unused at wave entry and reset at her turn start. Actions triggered by reactions and natural buff ticks do not qualify. Resolve after the enemy action; defeat of the recipient or Nyssara prevents the reaction. A mark clears on cleansing, expiry, either defeat or wave transition.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Mirage
mechanics.summary: Each ally can hold one Soryn-owned Mirage, initially none. Trickster's Guard and False Dawn grant it for 2 recipient turns; reapplying refreshes duration without stacking. Mirage reduces all direct damage from the next enemy action that directly damages that ally by 35%, including multi-hit damage within that same action, then is consumed at that action's end. A fully shield-absorbed direct hit still consumes it; DoTs and friendly damage do not. Expiry without a hit grants nothing. Glasslight Reflex may react to damage consumption, but Mirage's reduction works without that passive. Clear at wave end.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Roseward
mechanics.summary: Start with no Roseward. Glasshouse Sanctuary gives each living ally 1 owned Roseward for 2 recipient turns; cap 1 per ally, refresh never adds charges. After a hostile debuff would pass its normal Accuracy versus Resistance check, consume Roseward to block that one application. It does not block damage, break, gauge reduction, buff removal, mark consumption, or existing debuffs. Immune or resisted applications do not consume it. If an action applies several debuffs, only the first successful application is blocked; later debuffs can land. Wards clear on recipient defeat, Elowyn's defeat, or wave change. They cannot block unpreventable encounter mechanics.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Nectar Seal
mechanics.summary: A dispellable Elowyn-owned enemy mark, maximum 1 marked enemy. No mark at wave entry. Borrowed Nectar or Briar Communion attempts to place it after damage; a successful new application replaces her old mark, while a resisted application leaves the old mark unchanged. Borrowed Nectar lasts 2 target turns; Briar Communion lasts 3. After a living ally finishes its own ordinary damaging action that dealt direct HP damage to the marked enemy, heal that acting ally for 3% of its own Max HP, at most once per recipient between Elowyn's turns; allowances start unused at wave entry and reset at her turn start. Killing the marked enemy still earns this heal for a surviving attacker, then clears the mark. Shield-only hits, damage over time, counters, follow-ups, self-damage and other reactions do not qualify. Healing cannot crit or trigger any reactions. Mark and allowances clear on Elowyn's defeat or wave transition; target defeat also clears the mark. Each action checks the mark immediately before its first direct hit; it cannot earn this heal merely by applying a new Seal after that hit.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Rimeward
mechanics.summary: Enabled only by First Layer of Ice. Start with no marks. Whenever an Isavelle action grants a shield, each shield recipient gains one Rimeward mark, at most once per action. A mark reduces the first incoming direct enemy-action damage event by 15% before shield absorption, then is consumed; a multi-hit action consumes it on its first damaging hit only. It cannot reduce damage over time or reaction damage. Cap one per ally, never stack reductions, refresh for two recipient turns, and expire earlier if no shield granted by this Isavelle remains. Marks clear between waves and when Isavelle is defeated.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Reservoir
mechanics.summary: Enabled only by Unending Source. Start at zero, cap three, persist until spent, defeat or the wave ends. Gain one after her Basic or Active action restores at least one point of missing HP to any ally, at most once per action after spending. Overheal, regeneration ticks, other units' heals and Ultimates grant none. Springwater Touch spends one for an extra cleanse if available; Wellspring Incarnate spends all, up to three, for shielding. Auto spends the maximum allowed. This personal resource cannot transfer.
mechanics.retirementNote: Removed from current kits. Retained as an idea archive, not an active ability.

mechanics.name: Retorts
mechanics.summary: Enabled only by Held Ground. Start at zero, cap two, persist until spent, defeat or wave end. The first enemy action to deal positive direct damage to Valdra or a shield on her grants one Retort; maximum one gain from combat start to her first turn and one between each pair of her turns, reset at the start of her turn. Multi-hit, area hits, counters, damage over time and follow-ups cannot grant additional stacks. Answering Point spends up to two; no other skill spends them. Auto spends the maximum available. Personal and nontransferable.

relations.note: Cerys or Soryn Caldris can supply Burn for Veyra Wick to copy, refresh or extend. Those Wick actions trigger her gauge/charge passive; an ally's initial application does not directly charge Wick.
Cerys strengthens only Burn applications made through her applicable skill path, rather than amplifying every allied Burn.
Soryn Caldris strengthens her own Burn applications by 10%; this does not globally amplify an existing allied Burn.
Veyra Dusk strengthens her own Shadowfire applications. Wick's Burn system remains separate.
Future idea: let selected Burn consumers recognize Shadowfire, or give both a shared Burning tag. Current consumers check burn only; this requires a deliberate design and code change.
Future idea: let an explicitly selected venom skill benefit from either Poison or Toxin. Today Nerisse's Toxin spreading and consumption do not consume Aveline's Poison.
Aveline gets gauge only when her application reaches a not-yet-Poisoned target. Another source pre-Poisoning that target would prevent that particular bonus.
Bitter Eden reads pre-existing Poison for 25% more direct damage, without checking the source. Toxin does not qualify.

Measured in Threes Corrodes a target that already had Toxin; the Ultimate also Corrodes survivors when consuming 3 pre-cast stacks. The phrase already poisoned in content text means Toxin here, not Poison.
Nerisse's Resistance penalty helps Zahra land Conductive. Corroded also amplifies Zahra's ordinary hits and separate concept lightning arcs by 15%; the statuses remain separate.
Caelia's Noonwall Weakened enables Veloura's 14% damage bonus. The consumer does not require Veloura to own the debuff.
Any Chill enables Yselle's 16% damage bonus. Winterstep adds its own 28% shatter bonus, then consumes Chill. These content files currently provide no other hero who applies Chill.
Sevrin/Rhea Pierce and Party Break can set up Nemea's 16% bonus. No-Witness Step gains another 25% and consumes Exposed, removing its shared vulnerability for later allies.
A friendly break adds 28 Party Burst and attempts Exposed on each other living enemy, supporting damage beyond the broken boss.
Calcified raises Thessa's Petrify chance and her Accuracy. Successful Petrify consumes it; resistance leaves it intact.
Successful Petrify on an unbroken boss substitutes 35 gauge loss and Quarried. A currently Broken boss no longer passes that unbroken-boss check.
Calcified lowers Resistance by 10, helping Zahra apply Conductive and helping other checked hostile statuses. It does not add Conductive stacks by itself.
Both protect against checked debuffs: Clearwater raises allied Resistance, Diluted lowers hostile Accuracy. The two meet in the same application-chance formula.
Hartbound must be present before Maelis's action to earn the arrow; applying it that same action does not immediately fire one. Her Ultimate raises arrow power and can extend the buff.
An intercepted hit adds Temper and triggers Adela's counter afterward. The hit only benefits from stacks already present before the new one is granted.
Thermal Screen spends Temper for 10% plus 3% reduction per stack, capped at 19%. Furnace Standard instead sets Temper to 3 and separately grants 18% Screened.
Adela's Screened and Sivra's consumed Frostplate can reduce the same direct hit multiplicatively. Frostplate is a charge rather than Shield; its consumption reactions can still occur.
Consumed allied Frostplate heals living Sivra for 1.5% Max HP once per affected ally for that action. The reaction finds Sivra without checking the plate's source owner.
With Breakwater active, allied Frostplate consumption triggers Sivra's counterwave once per enemy action, even if several allies lose plates.
Future idea: a selected frost skill could apply Chill when Frostplate is consumed. They are unrelated today, so Sivra does not automatically feed Yselle's shatter loop.
Any teammate's Shield can maintain Caelia's 15 Resistance condition because it checks her Shield value, not its source. DoT ticks still bypass the shield.
Maelin's dedicated cleanse-heal skills give her bonus heal and charge. A heal/cleanse from another hero does not invoke that bonus.
Stillwater's barrier equals 8% of each recipient's Max HP plus 4% per debuff removed, capped at 20%. More cleanse work directly raises its prevention.

Jianne's Chorus improves Maelis's ordinary attacks and effective Speed, but the Spirit Arrow helper does not read Chorus's damage bonus. Do not grant the arrow the same bonus in catalogue calculations.
Chorus improves Zahra's ordinary hits and turn frequency. Her separate lightning arcs do not read its damage bonus, though Corroded explicitly amplifies them.
Iori's 10% Healing Received boost raises Luna's turn-start Max-HP heal, which explicitly reads that stat.
Jianne's Healing Received boost improves ordinary healing. Her own heals also cleanse through the standard resolver, but the boost does not increase debuffs removed.
Astra grants 12 starting charge and gauge to every ally, bringing Ultimate setups forward without a repeating engine.
Tamsin's 18 opening Party Burst combines with normal hit/break gains. A later friendly non-Basic action spends the shared meter at 100.
Rhea's starting Resistance reduction helps Zahra's checked Conductive applications and other checked debuffs. Its Speed reduction is a direct stat change rather than a slow status.
A hero Ultimate deploys its Domain and adds 24 Party Burst before ActionScale checks the meter, so it can fill and spend the meter in the same action.
Unbroken bosses receive Root's 30-gauge fallback. A Broken boss no longer passes that test, allowing normal Root if the application succeeds.
Nerisse's Corroded amplifies Adela's counter because the concept-reaction helper explicitly reads corroded, without requiring ownership.
Future idea: let a Wick skill convert or copy Shadowfire as Burn to create a deliberate Dusk–Wick pairing. Current Borrow the Wick cannot copy Shadowfire, and its refresh cannot extend it.

Roselle's shield-break healing accepts temporary HP shields from any hero. Enemy damage must break them; expiry and voluntary consumption do not count. Frostplate charges are not automatically HP shields.
Isavelle's straightforward guardian passive protects allies with any hero's shield. Roselle or the court supports can provide those shields.
Liora reads Speed down from any source. Isavelle, Orivelle or Miravelle can supply it; no private mark is required.
Nyssara's straightforward control passive reads ordinary Speed down from allies as well as herself.
Seressa's damage bonus reads any healing-reduction debuff. Nerielle's brackish kit can set it up.
Nerielle also reads any healing reduction, so Seressa's anti-heal attacks can set up her bonus.
Valdra's passive accepts any ordinary Burn or her own Rosebrand. Her Ultimate still consumes only her own Rosebrand, never an ally's Burn.
Soryn's follow-up can be enabled by any ally newly breaking a surviving enemy. It keeps its once-per-Soryn-turn limit.
Seressa rewards another ally using a Basic. Basic-focused resource generators can benefit from this team style, but her follow-up does not generate their private resources.
Soryn heals another ally after that ally uses an Ultimate. Ordinary charge supports can enable the cadence; the triggered heal grants no new charge.
Possible future link: let Poison-family bonuses recognize Venomweave while keeping Nyssara's stack ownership and consumption private. Today ordinary Poison cannot fuel her Venomweave spenders.

Possible future link: explicitly tag Rosebrand as a Burn subtype for readers such as Veyra Wick. Do not assume her Burn copy/refresh currently accepts Rosebrand, or allow her to spend Valdra's owned brand.
Roselle's assembled kit heals when enemy damage breaks any hero's HP shield on an ally. It shares two triggers during each unit's turn; voluntary Ultimate consumption never triggers it.

Allied HP shields on Roselle can fuel her assembled Ultimate: spend once, convert 50%, cap the bonus at 35% Roselle Max HP per enemy. Reaching it needs 70% Max HP of current shielding. Separate named source layers are a proposed implementation; current runtime ordinary barriers use one maximum Shield value. Allies retain shields on themselves.

abilities.name: Two Points of Light

abilities.description: At action start select a distinct living, normally targetable secondary enemy if one exists. Deal 85% ATK to the primary and 20% ATK to that secondary in the same action. summary: Deal 125% ATK to one enemy and 50% ATK to a different enemy.

abilities.description: Deal 80% ATK to each enemy. Attempt Effect Accuracy down by 15 percentage points for 2 target turns on each, once per target. Use the strongest generic Accuracy reduction and a minimum 0 Accuracy; unpreventable encounter effects are unchanged. This does not reduce enemy critical chance or damage and does not apply Barbed Accord.
abilities.mixNote: Area utility suppression without Charm; enemy applications can still succeed.
summary: Deal 80% ATK to all enemies.
Reduce their Effect Accuracy by 15% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: The Devil's Terms
abilities.target: One enemy; auto: highest action gauge, then highest ATK, then lower formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 210% ATK to the target. If it survives, attempt Barbed Accord for 3 target turns, replacing her old brand on success. After that bearer finishes an ordinary Active1 or Active2 while both are alive, it takes 40% of Miravelle's ATK, at most once per bearer turn. Brand damage cannot crit, grant charge, inflict break or trigger reactions; Basics, Ultimates, skipped actions and encounter events do not trigger it. Mark clears on owner defeat, bearer defeat or wave transition.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone strike and brand; no Charm or finisher dependency.
summary: Deal 210% ATK to one enemy.
Apply Barbed Accord for 3 turns: after either Active, it takes 40% ATK damage, once per enemy turn; only one Accord may exist.

abilities.name: Red beneath the Wings
abilities.target: Self
abilities.description: While below 50% HP, Miravelle deals 20% more direct action damage and gains Healing Received up 15%, using the strongest generic Healing Received increase. Check her HP after an action's HP cost and before its first direct hit; keep that result for the whole action. The damage bonus does not affect damage over time, counters or follow-ups. The effects grant no damage immunity or death prevention and end on her defeat.
abilities.mixNote: A fixed bonus below 50% HP works with any attacking skill; healing above the threshold removes it.
summary: While Miravelle is below 50% HP, increase her attack damage by 20% and her Healing Received by 15%.

abilities.name: Taste of the Chase
abilities.target: One enemy; auto: lowest HP percentage, ties lower formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 95% ATK. After the whole action, if Miravelle lives, heal her for 10% of actual direct HP damage this action dealt, capped at 3% of her Max HP before Healing Received modifiers. Killing-blow HP damage counts; overkill, shield damage and follow-ups do not. This triggered drain cannot crit, grant charge or trigger healing reactions.
abilities.mixNote: Small recovery with no required low-HP state; shield-only damage yields no healing.
summary: Deal 95% ATK to one enemy.
Heal Miravelle for 10% of the HP damage dealt, up to 3% of her Max HP.

abilities.name: Cut the Red Horizon
abilities.target: One enemy; auto: highest DEF, then highest current HP, then lower formation slot
abilities.description: Before damage, pay 5% of Miravelle's Max HP as a nonlethal cost, limited to her current HP minus 1. Shields, mitigation and immunity cannot pay or reduce this cost; it is not damage and triggers no reactions or charge. Then deal 150% ATK, ignoring 15% of the target's DEF. No bonus is proportional to how much HP was paid; Red beneath the Wings checks whether she is below 50% HP after payment.
abilities.mixNote: DEF penetration is self-contained; importing the skill always keeps its HP cost.
summary: Pay 5% of Miravelle's Max HP without dropping below 1 HP.
Deal 150% ATK to one enemy, ignoring 15% of its DEF.

abilities.name: Scarlet Wingbeat
abilities.target: All enemies
abilities.description: Before damage, pay 8% of Miravelle's Max HP as a nonlethal cost, limited to her current HP minus 1. This cost bypasses shields, mitigation and immunity, counts as no damage, and triggers no reactions or charge. Deal 100% ATK to each enemy as one ordinary area action; normal Active charge is gained once. Red beneath the Wings checks whether she is below 50% HP after payment. No shield or healing is granted by this action.
abilities.mixNote: Area pressure can trigger an imported action-damage Passive, but never grants a separate turn or refunds the HP cost.
summary: Pay 8% of Miravelle's Max HP without dropping below 1 HP.
Deal 100% ATK to all enemies.

abilities.name: Drink the Dusk
abilities.target: All enemies
abilities.description: Deal 145% ATK to each enemy. After the whole action, if Miravelle lives, heal her for 10% of actual direct HP damage dealt by this action, capped at 12% of her Max HP before Healing Received modifiers. Killing-blow HP damage counts; overkill, shield damage, damage over time and follow-ups do not. This drain cannot crit or trigger healing reactions, grants no charge and costs no extra HP beyond the normal 100-charge payment. Any Passive follow-up is excluded from its drain total.
abilities.mixNote: A draining area finish without an HP threshold; it cannot recover HP against unbroken shields.
summary: Deal 145% ATK to all enemies.
Heal Miravelle for 10% of the total HP damage dealt, up to 12% of her Max HP.

abilities.name: Weight of Winter
abilities.target: Primary enemy damaged by her action
abilities.description: After her Basic, Active or Ultimate finishes its direct damage and listed effects, if its primary target is alive and has any Speed down, attempt to apply 15% ATK down to that target for two target turns. Check once per caster action; follow-ups and damage over time cannot trigger this. An area action uses its selected primary target only.
abilities.mixNote: Works with her slowing skills or an ally's Speed down; a mixed kit without either will not trigger it.
summary: After Isavelle's attack and its effects resolve, reduce the main target's ATK by 15% for 2 turns if it is slowed.
Triggers once per Isavelle skill.

abilities.name: Winter Needle
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 90% ATK damage and attempt to apply 10% Speed down for one target turn. Weight of Winter checks after this application, so a successful slow can immediately enable its ATK down.
abilities.mixNote: A dependable slow replaces some Basic damage; imports cleanly into her defense kit.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy.
Reduce their Speed by 10% for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Royal Stillness
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 120% ATK damage and attempt Freeze for one target turn, denying its next action. After a successful denial, the target is control-immune through its following actionable turn. A Freeze-immune target receives no control or replacement effect. Direct attack damage still occurs and follows shared Break rules.
abilities.mixNote: A standalone interrupt. Against an immune boss it retains normal damage, without a replacement effect.
summary: Deal 120% ATK damage to one enemy and Freeze them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Whiteout Procession
abilities.target: All enemies
abilities.description: Deal 80% of Isavelle's ATK damage to each enemy, then attempt 20% Speed down on each survivor for two target turns, once per target. Select a primary enemy for Weight of Winter; its check occurs after these debuff attempts. This skill does not reduce action gauge.
abilities.mixNote: A standalone area slow. It trades damage and shielding for broad Speed control.
summary: Deal 80% ATK damage to all enemies.
Reduce their Speed by 20% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Edict of Winter
abilities.target: All enemies
abilities.description: Deal 130% ATK damage to all enemies and attempt one-turn Freeze on each, denying one action. Successful denial grants standard control immunity through the following actionable turn. Freeze-immune targets receive no control or replacement effect. Select a primary target for Weight of Winter. Direct damage still follows shared Break rules.
abilities.mixNote: Emergency area control; immune bosses still take the normal attack damage.
summary: Deal 130% ATK damage to all enemies and Freeze them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: First Layer of Ice
abilities.target: Allies receiving her shields
abilities.description: While Isavelle is alive, each living ally with any active shield takes 10% less direct enemy-action damage. Check whether the ally has a shield before each incoming hit and apply reduction before shield absorption. A hit that breaks the shield is reduced; subsequent unshielded hits are not. Damage over time and reactions are unaffected. This named reduction uses only the strongest copy and multiplies with other reductions. There are no marks or charges.
abilities.mixNote: Works with any allied shield; no shield resource or mark is required.
summary: While Isavelle is alive, allies with a shield take 10% less direct damage from enemy attacks.
The protection ends when their shield is gone.

abilities.name: Ice-Rimmed Scepter
abilities.target: One enemy; self
abilities.description: Deal 90% of Isavelle's ATK damage to one enemy and grant herself a shield equal to 4% of her own Max HP for two own turns. This named shield does not stack with itself; refresh it to the higher remaining or new value. The shield is granted even if the attack is absorbed or defeats its target.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone personal sustain; the shield and damage work without First Layer of Ice.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy.
Give Isavelle a shield equal to 4% of her Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Icicle Challenge
abilities.target: One enemy; self
abilities.description: Deal 105% of Isavelle's ATK damage to one enemy and attempt Provoke for one target turn, restricting its offensive single-target skills to Isavelle. Grant herself a shield equal to 12% of her Max HP for two own turns even if Provoke fails or is immune. Bosses are immune to Provoke and receive no substitute; damage and shielding still occur. This skill grants no separate damage-reduction buff.
abilities.mixNote: Self-contained protection; it still works when a boss ignores Provoke.
summary: Deal 105% ATK damage to one enemy and Provoke them for 1 turn.
Give Isavelle a shield equal to 12% of her Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Mantle of the North

abilities.mixNote: A clean import for either damage or control: party protection needs no resource or passive.
summary: Give every ally a shield equal to 8% of Isavelle's Max HP for 2 turns.
Increase their DEF by 15% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Palace of Glass
abilities.target: All enemies; all living allies

abilities.mixNote: A standalone party shield. Import a cleansing skill separately if needed.
summary: Deal 100% ATK damage to all enemies.
Give every ally a shield equal to 15% of Isavelle's Max HP for 2 turns.

After a damaging Basic or Active, gain 1 Facet, up to 4. Facets last until spent or the wave ends.

abilities.name: Cleft Shard

Reduce their DEF by 15% for 2 turns.

Spend up to 2 Facets to add 15% ATK damage each, up to 170% ATK total.

abilities.description: If at least one Facet is available, spend one before damage. Deal 95% of Isavelle's ATK damage to each enemy. abilities.mixNote: The area damage works alone; Perfect Fracture enables its optional DEF down.
summary: Deal 95% ATK damage to all enemies.
Spend 1 Facet, if available, to reduce their DEF by 20% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Crownfall Fracture

abilities.description: Spend all available Facets, up to four. Deal 200% ATK damage plus 10% ATK per Facet spent, in one direct attack that ignores 20% of the target's DEF. abilities.mixNote: A standalone single-target finisher; maximum burst asks you to save Facets rather than spend them on actives.
summary: Deal 200% ATK damage to one enemy, ignoring 20% of their DEF.
Spend all Facets to add 10% ATK damage each, up to 240% ATK total.

Encounter-locked buffs, reactions and damage over time do not qualify.

Her attacks ignore 15% of DEF against enemies that have a removable buff before she attacks.

summary: Remove 1 buff from one enemy with a 60% base chance.
Then deal 95% ATK damage to them.

abilities.name: Uncrown the Pretender
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses most removable buffs, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Attempt to remove up to two removable buffs in one accuracy/resistance check; success removes the oldest two or all if fewer exist. Then deal 140% of Isavelle's ATK damage. No removable buffs or a resisted dispel leaves the full attack intact. Removal precedes damage, but Shard Against Splendor still uses the pre-action state.
abilities.mixNote: A complete single-target attack and dispel. It trades Royal Stillness's Freeze or Needle Through Stone's optional Facet damage boost for buff removal.
summary: Remove up to 2 buffs from one enemy.
Then deal 140% ATK damage to them.

abilities.name: White Mirror Procession
abilities.target: All enemies; primary enemy follows the most-removable-buffs auto rule
abilities.description: Deal 75% of Isavelle's ATK damage to each enemy, then attempt to remove one removable buff from each survivor, oldest first, with one normal accuracy/resistance check per enemy. Shard Against Splendor uses each target's removable-buff state before this action began. This skill grants no ally buff.
abilities.mixNote: Straightforward area dispel; it needs no resource or passive.
summary: Deal 75% ATK damage to all enemies.
Remove 1 buff from each enemy.

abilities.name: Mirrorbreak Coronation
abilities.target: All enemies; primary enemy follows the most-removable-buffs auto rule
abilities.description: For each enemy, attempt to remove up to two removable buffs in one normal accuracy/resistance check, oldest first, then deal 140% of Isavelle's ATK damage. Locked buffs stay in place. Full damage still occurs if removal fails; Shard Against Splendor uses the pre-action buff state. No allied DEF buff is granted.
abilities.mixNote: A stronger area dispel; choose party protection in another slot if needed.
summary: Remove up to 2 buffs from every enemy.
Then deal 140% ATK damage to all enemies.

abilities.name: Stillwater Vigil
abilities.target: All living allies; enemy bearing her Icebound Reprisal
abilities.description: While Isavelle is alive, all living allies have 10 percentage points of Effect Resistance, using the strongest generic Effect Resistance buff or aura. They also take 8% less direct enemy-action damage from the enemy currently bearing this Isavelle's Icebound Reprisal, multiplicative with other reduction; duplicate copies of this named reduction use only the strongest. This reduction is checked before damage and shield absorption. Reactions and damage over time receive no reduction.
abilities.mixNote: Resistance works alone. Keep one mark provider to retain the focused reduction.
summary: Increase all allies' Effect Resistance by 10% while Isavelle is alive.
Her Icebound Reprisal target deals 8% less direct damage to allies.

abilities.name: Quiet Snowfall
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses highest ATK, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 95% of Isavelle's ATK damage and attempt 10% ATK down for one target turn. The debuff checks once after damage. A killing blow still resolves damage but does not place a debuff on a defeated target.
abilities.mixNote: A resource-free reduction to one enemy's next offensive window.
summary: Deal 95% ATK damage to one enemy.
Reduce their ATK by 10% for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Seal of the Quiet Lake
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses highest ATK, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 110% of Isavelle's ATK damage, then attempt Icebound Reprisal on the surviving target for two target turns. Its next qualifying direct hostile action triggers one 60% snapshotted Isavelle-ATK retaliation after that action, consuming the mark. It counts shield-only damage and killing blows but requires Isavelle and the attacker to survive. Retaliation cannot crit, grant charge or trigger reactions. Owning a new mark replaces her previous one only on successful application.
abilities.mixNote: The mark is self-contained and requires no passive. Reduced immediate damage pays for its delayed strike.
summary: Deal 110% ATK damage and apply Icebound Reprisal for 2 turns. Only 1 enemy can bear it.
After they next damage an ally, consume it to retaliate for 60% ATK damage if both combatants survive.

abilities.name: Shelter in Silence
abilities.target: All living allies
abilities.description: Remove one removable debuff from each living ally, oldest first, then heal each for 6% of that recipient's Max HP. It cannot remove unremovable encounter mechanics or revive defeated units. This action grants no DEF buff or shield and cannot trigger Icebound Reprisal.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone cleanse and party healing; no mark is required.
summary: Remove 1 debuff from every ally.
Heal each ally for 6% of their own Max HP.

abilities.name: The Long Cold Answer
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses highest ATK, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 180% of Isavelle's ATK damage and attempt Icebound Reprisal on the surviving target for two target turns. Its next qualifying hostile action supplies the same single 60% snapshotted-ATK retaliation as Seal of the Quiet Lake, never an additional stacked mark. Grant all living allies shields equal to 8% of Isavelle's Max HP for two recipient turns even if the enemy dies or resists. Each named shield refreshes to the higher remaining or new value.
abilities.mixNote: Gives a shield even when the mark fails. Reapplying a pending mark refreshes it, never stores a second retaliation.
summary: Deal 180% ATK damage and apply Icebound Reprisal for 2 turns: their next damaging attack triggers one 60% ATK retaliation if both combatants survive.
Shield all allies for 8% of Isavelle's Max HP for 2 turns. Only 1 enemy can bear her mark.

abilities.name: Unending Source
abilities.target: Self; her healing recipients
abilities.description: While Nerielle is alive, multiply healing amounts from her own selected skills, including their regeneration ticks, by 1.10. This changes the amount healed, not Max HP, shield strength or the normal healing cap. It does not improve another unit's healing. There is no resource generation or spending.
abilities.mixNote: Improves any of Nerielle's imported healing skills, including self-healing and regeneration.
summary: Increase healing from Nerielle's skills by 10%.
This also increases the regeneration she applies.

abilities.name: Droplet's Return
abilities.target: One enemy; living ally with lowest HP percentage
abilities.description: Deal 90% of Nerielle's ATK damage to one enemy, then heal the living ally with the lowest HP percentage for 3% of that recipient's Max HP. Ties choose the lowest formation slot; Nerielle can receive it. Healing occurs even if the attack misses, is absorbed or defeats the target. No resource is generated.
abilities.mixNote: Repeatable small ally healing; it needs no passive.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy.
Heal the ally with the lowest HP percentage for 3% of that ally's Max HP.

abilities.name: Springwater Touch
abilities.target: One living ally
abilities.description: Heal one living ally for 18% of that recipient's Max HP and remove up to two removable debuffs, oldest first. Both cleanses are unconditional and require no resource; unremovable mechanics remain. Auto chooses the ally with the lowest HP percentage, then most removable debuffs, then lowest formation slot.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone burst healing and a two-debuff cleanse.
summary: Heal one ally for 18% of their own Max HP.
Remove up to 2 debuffs from that ally.

abilities.name: Restoring Rain
abilities.target: All living allies
abilities.description: Heal every living ally for 8% of that recipient's Max HP. Grant each regeneration that heals 4% of their own Max HP at the start of each of their next two turns. This named regeneration refreshes duration rather than stacking; the strongest generic regeneration amount applies. It generates no resource.
abilities.mixNote: Reliable party sustain; it does not depend on earlier healing.
summary: Heal all allies for 8% of their own Max HP.
Give each regeneration that restores 4% of their own Max HP at the start of their next 2 turns.

abilities.name: Wellspring Incarnate
abilities.target: All living allies
abilities.description: Remove one removable debuff from each living ally, oldest first, then heal each for 18% of that recipient's Max HP. Unremovable encounter mechanics remain, and defeated allies are not revived. This skill grants no shield and requires no resource.
abilities.mixNote: A direct emergency party heal and cleanse; no setup is needed.
summary: Remove 1 debuff from every ally, then heal each for 18% of its own Max HP.

abilities.name: Borrowed Momentum
abilities.target: Living ally with lowest action gauge
abilities.description: Once per Nerielle action, after her skill successfully reduces any enemy action gauge or deals positive Break damage to an intact gauge, advance the living ally with the lowest action gauge by 8%. Ties choose the lowest formation slot; Nerielle may receive it. This is one push for the whole action, never per enemy or hit. Triggered damage and reactions cannot activate it; gauge cannot exceed its normal cap.
abilities.mixNote: Keep a gauge-reducing or Break skill. A mixed healing-only kit gives this passive no trigger.
summary: After Nerielle reduces an enemy's action gauge or damages an intact Break gauge, advance the ally with the lowest action gauge by 8%.
Triggers once per Nerielle action.

abilities.name: Pebble in the Current
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy. It applies no gauge reduction. Borrowed Momentum can trigger only if the shared elemental-advantage Break rule removes a positive point from an intact gauge; a neutral Basic deals no Break.

summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Deepwater Pull
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 135% ATK damage and attempt to reduce the target's action gauge by 15%. An immune target receives no gauge reduction or replacement effect. Borrowed Momentum, if selected, may grant its single 8% ally push after successful gauge reduction or normal positive Break damage to an intact gauge.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone damage and gauge delay; immune bosses receive normal damage and shared Break only.

Reduce their action gauge by 15%.

abilities.target: All enemies

This skill applies no Speed down. Borrowed Momentum can trigger at most once for the whole action, including when ordinary shared Break removes positive points from an intact gauge.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone area delay; immune bosses still take normal damage. It provides no healing.
summary: Deal 80% ATK damage to all enemies.
Reduce their action gauges by 10%.

abilities.name: Riptide Reversal
abilities.target: All enemies
abilities.description: Deal 135% of Nerielle's ATK damage to every enemy, then attempt a 15% action-gauge reduction on each survivor. Immune targets receive no gauge reduction or replacement effect. Borrowed Momentum can grant at most one 8% ally push after successful gauge reduction or normal positive Break damage. This skill does not dispel buffs.
abilities.mixNote: Broad tempo control; it trades the other Ultimates' healing or burst for delay.
summary: Deal 135% ATK damage to all enemies.
Reduce their action gauges by 15%.

abilities.name: Reforming Current
abilities.target: Self
abilities.description: Start with zero Crests, cap three. Completing one of Nerielle's own Basic actions grants one Crest once per action, even if damage is absorbed. Other slots and triggered attacks grant none. At the start of an own turn with at least one Crest, heal herself for 4% of her Max HP once, without spending a Crest. Crests remain until spent, defeat or the wave ends and cannot transfer.
abilities.mixNote: Any imported Basic still builds Crests; retain a Crest between turns for self-healing.
summary: After Nerielle uses a Basic, gain 1 Crest, up to 3.
If Nerielle has a Crest at the start of her turn, heal her for 4% of her Max HP without spending it. Crests last until spent or the wave ends.

abilities.name: Piercing Stream

abilities.mixNote: Her strongest plain Basic; choosing it gives up the other options' ally healing, self-healing or healing reduction.
summary: Deal 105% ATK damage to one enemy.
If Reforming Current is selected, gain 1 Crest after this attack.

abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: If a Crest is available, spend one before attacking. Deal 150% ATK damage, plus 20% ATK if a Crest was spent, as one direct attack. summary: Deal 150% ATK damage to one enemy.
Spend 1 Crest, if available, to increase this to 170% ATK damage.

The named shield refreshes rather than stacking. This skill applies no ATK down and generates no Crests.
abilities.mixNote: Area damage stands alone; Reforming Current enables the optional personal shield.
summary: Deal 95% ATK damage to all enemies.
Spend 1 Crest, if available, to shield Nerielle for 8% of her Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Falling Ocean

abilities.description: Spend all available Crests, up to three. Deal 210% ATK damage plus 10% ATK per Crest spent as one attack, capped at 240% ATK. After the attack, heal herself for 8% of her Max HP even at zero Crests or if the attack is absorbed. This Ultimate generates no Crests or charge.

summary: Deal 210% ATK damage to one enemy. Spend all Crests to add 10% ATK damage each, up to 240% ATK total.
Heal Nerielle for 8% of her Max HP.

When Waterbound Link transfers damage to her, heal her for 3% of her Max HP afterward. Up to once per Nerielle turn.
