abilities.target: One other living ally; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then lowest formation slot; if none exists, self-heal only
abilities.description: Heal the chosen other ally for 12% of that recipient's Max HP and apply Waterbound Link for two recipient turns. It transfers 20% of qualifying post-shield direct enemy-action HP damage to Nerielle, at most 8% of Nerielle's Max HP per enemy action and never more than her current HP minus one. Overflow stays on the ally; transfer ignores a second shield or reduction and triggers no reactions. If no other ally lives, instead heal Nerielle for 12% of her own Max HP and apply no link.
abilities.mixNote: The protection works without the passive, but sustained transfer needs healing for Nerielle.
summary: Heal one other ally for 12% of their Max HP and link them for 2 turns.
Transfer 20% of their incoming HP damage to Nerielle, capped at 8% of her Max HP per enemy attack. Transfer cannot defeat Nerielle. Only 1 ally can be linked.

abilities.name: Estuary Reformation
abilities.target: Self and all living allies
abilities.description: Heal Nerielle for 12% of her own Max HP and give each living ally regeneration that restores 4% of that recipient's Max HP at the start of each of their next two turns. This named regeneration refreshes rather than stacking; use the strongest generic regeneration amount. It does not cleanse, trigger link transfer or trigger A Body That Reforms.
abilities.mixNote: Restores Nerielle while sustaining allies; it requires no existing link.
summary: Heal Nerielle for 12% of her Max HP.
Give all allies regeneration that restores 4% of their own Max HP at the start of their next 2 turns.

abilities.name: One Sea Between Us
abilities.target: All living allies; link the other ally with lowest HP percentage, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Grant each living ally a shield equal to 10% of Nerielle's Max HP for two recipient turns, refreshing the named shield to its higher remaining or new value. Then apply Waterbound Link to the other living ally with the lowest HP percentage, ties by lowest formation slot, for two recipient turns. It has the same 20% post-shield transfer, total cap of 8% of Nerielle's Max HP per whole enemy action, one-HP floor and expiry as Tributary Bond; excess stays with the ally. It replaces any previous link. If no other ally lives, create no link. This skill gives shields even without another ally, but performs no direct healing.
abilities.mixNote: Party shields stand alone. The link enables the passive's bounded recovery, but this Ultimate does not directly heal.
summary: Shield all allies for 10% of Nerielle's Max HP for 2 turns.

Link the other ally with the lowest HP percentage for 2 turns: transfer 20% of their incoming HP damage to Nerielle, capped at 8% of her Max HP per enemy attack. Transfer cannot defeat her; only 1 ally can be linked.

abilities.name: Salt Remembers
abilities.target: Self; enemies damaged by her direct actions
abilities.description: While alive, Nerielle has 10 percentage points of Effect Resistance, using the strongest generic Effect Resistance buff or aura. Her direct action damage is increased by 15% multiplicatively against a target that already had any healing-reduction debuff when her action began. Snapshot each target before applying new debuffs. Damage over time and reactions do not receive this bonus.
abilities.mixNote: The resistance works alone; her own healing reduction or an ally's can enable the damage bonus.
summary: Increase Nerielle's Effect Resistance by 10%.
Her attacks deal 15% more damage to enemies already affected by healing reduction.

abilities.name: Brine Thread
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses highest current regeneration amount, then highest HP percentage, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 95% of Nerielle's ATK damage, then attempt 25% healing reduction for one target turn. This reduces incoming direct heals, regeneration and lifesteal by 25%; it does not affect shields or scripted HP setting. Use the strongest healing-reduction amount, never add them. The newly applied debuff does not enable Salt Remembers retroactively.
abilities.mixNote: A self-contained anti-healing Basic that trades Piercing Stream's damage or Droplet's Return's ally heal.
summary: Deal 95% ATK damage to one enemy.
Reduce their incoming healing by 25% for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Bitterwater Jet
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses highest current regeneration amount, then highest HP percentage, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 140% of Nerielle's ATK damage to one enemy, then attempt 40% healing reduction on the survivor for two target turns. It reduces direct heals, regeneration and lifesteal, not shields or scripted HP setting. Use the strongest generic healing-reduction amount. This skill applies no DEF down.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone focus-fire suppression; no resource or passive is needed.
summary: Deal 140% ATK damage to one enemy.
Reduce their incoming healing by 40% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Saltwater Bloom
abilities.target: All enemies; primary auto chooses highest current regeneration amount, then highest HP percentage, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 85% of Nerielle's ATK damage to each enemy, then attempt 30% healing reduction on each survivor for two target turns, once per target. It reduces direct heals, regeneration and lifesteal; use the strongest amount rather than stacking. This skill applies no ATK down.
abilities.mixNote: Sustained area suppression. It replaces party recovery or stronger gauge control.
summary: Deal 85% ATK damage to all enemies.
Reduce their incoming healing by 30% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Brackwater Dominion
abilities.target: All enemies; primary auto chooses highest current regeneration amount, then highest HP percentage, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 140% of Nerielle's ATK damage to each enemy, then attempt 50% healing reduction on each survivor for two target turns, once per target. It reduces direct healing, regeneration and lifesteal, never shields or scripted HP setting; use the strongest generic reduction. This skill does not dispel buffs.
abilities.mixNote: Strong anti-healing coverage; it contributes no emergency heal, shield or dispel.
summary: Deal 140% ATK damage to all enemies.
Reduce their incoming healing by 50% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Crack the Guard
abilities.target: Enemies damaged by her actions
abilities.description: Her direct Basic, Active and Ultimate actions deal 15% more damage to enemies with a real Break gauge that was already depleted before that action began. The hit that first breaks the gauge gains no bonus from this passive. An enemy with no Break gauge receives no damage bonus. Counters, follow-ups and damage over time receive no bonus. This passive never adds Break.
abilities.mixNote: A simple payoff for a shared Broken window; every imported attack can benefit, but none gains added Break.
summary: Valdra's attacks deal 15% more damage to enemies whose Break gauge is already depleted.
Enemies with no Break gauge do not count as broken.

abilities.name: Testing Thrust
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 100% ATK damage to one enemy. It uses only shared Break; a neutral Basic deals none.
abilities.mixNote: A direct Basic; elemental advantage determines whether it contributes normal Break.
summary: Deal 100% ATK damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Guard-Splitting Lunge
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 150% ATK damage to one enemy. It applies no Provoke, personal protection or added Break.
abilities.mixNote: A straightforward single-target damage import without setup.
summary: Deal 150% ATK damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Cleaving Sweep
abilities.target: All enemies
abilities.description: Deal 90% of Valdra's ATK damage to each enemy. This skill applies no DEF down or added Break; damaged enemies receive only the shared normal Break for the action.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone area damage; it gives up party defense or healing.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to all enemies.

abilities.name: Redline Impalement
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 220% of Valdra's ATK damage to one enemy. Crack the Guard, if selected, checks whether the enemy's real Break gauge was already depleted before the action begins and then grants its 15% direct-damage bonus. This skill uses only shared Ultimate Break and has no separate DEF ignore or execute effect.
abilities.mixNote: A direct finisher; Crack the Guard rewards using it during an existing Broken window.
summary: Deal 220% ATK damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Held Ground
abilities.target: Self
abilities.description: While Valdra is alive, reduce direct enemy-action damage to her by 10%, multiplicative with other reductions. Apply it before shield absorption. Damage over time, reactions and self-paid HP are unaffected. This named reduction uses only the strongest copy. There are no resources, retaliation charges or hit requirements.
abilities.mixNote: Unconditional personal protection; it works with any imported skill.
summary: Valdra takes 10% less direct damage from enemy attacks.
This protection is always active while she is alive.

abilities.name: Braced Jab
abilities.target: One enemy; self
abilities.description: Deal 90% of Valdra's ATK damage to one enemy and grant herself 15% DEF up for one own turn. Use the strongest generic DEF-up amount rather than stacking. The buff applies even if the attack is absorbed or defeats its target.
abilities.mixNote: A defensive Basic that works without Held Ground; other choices offer higher direct damage, ally healing or Burn.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy.
Increase Valdra's DEF by 15% for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Thorn Challenge
abilities.target: One enemy; self
abilities.description: Deal 120% of Valdra's ATK damage to one enemy, attempt Provoke for one target turn, and grant herself a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP for two own turns. Provoke restricts offensive single-target skills to Valdra. An immune target receives no Provoke or replacement effect; damage and shielding still occur. No resource is generated.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone personal protection; immune bosses still take normal damage while Valdra receives the shield.
summary: Deal 120% ATK damage to one enemy and Provoke them for 1 turn.
Shield Valdra for 10% of her Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Answering Point
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 130% of Valdra's ATK damage to one enemy, then heal herself for 8% of her Max HP if alive. The full heal occurs even if the attack misses, is absorbed or defeats its target. This skill has no resource requirement, scaling spender or counter damage.
abilities.mixNote: A reliable damage-and-recovery action; no setup is required.
summary: Deal 130% ATK damage to one enemy.
Heal Valdra for 8% of her Max HP, even if the attack is absorbed.

abilities.name: Lasting Thorn
abilities.target: One enemy; all living allies; self
abilities.description: Deal 140% of Valdra's ATK damage to one enemy, then grant each living ally a shield equal to 10% of Valdra's Max HP for two recipient turns. Refresh this named shield to the higher remaining or new value rather than stacking. Shielding occurs even if the attack is absorbed or defeats its target. This skill applies no Provoke and grants no retaliation stance.
abilities.mixNote: A party-protection Ultimate; it trades personal damage for shields.
summary: Deal 140% ATK damage to one enemy.
Give all allies a shield equal to 10% of Valdra's Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Steady Orders
abilities.target: All living allies
abilities.description: While Valdra is alive, living allies have 8% DEF up; use the strongest DEF-up amount rather than stacking generic DEF buffs. Once per allied Basic or Active action, if that action deals direct damage to an enemy bearing this Valdra's Rally Point, grant its acting ally four bonus ultimate charge after the action, capped at 100. Valdra can receive this reward. Ultimates, damage over time and reactions never trigger it; multiple hits or targets give no additional charge.
abilities.mixNote: The DEF aura works alone; Set the Line or Crimson Standard is needed for its charge reward.
summary: Increase all allies' DEF by 8% while Valdra is alive.
When an ally's Basic or Active damages her Rally Point target, give that ally 4 extra Ultimate charge. Once per action.

abilities.name: Covering Point
abilities.target: One enemy; living ally with lowest HP percentage
abilities.description: Deal 95% ATK damage to one enemy, then heal the living ally with the lowest HP percentage for 3% of that recipient's Max HP. Ties choose the lowest formation slot; Valdra can receive the heal. Healing still happens if the attack is absorbed. If the enemy bears her Rally Point and Steady Orders is selected, its once-per-action charge reward can trigger.
abilities.mixNote: A small party-sustain import, trading away higher plain damage, personal DEF or Burn pressure.
summary: Deal 95% ATK damage to one enemy.
Heal the ally with the lowest HP percentage for 3% of that ally's Max HP.

abilities.name: Set the Line
abilities.target: One enemy
abilities.description: Deal 135% ATK damage, then attempt Rally Point for two target turns. Her party's direct action damage to the marked target is increased by 8%; reactions and damage over time do not benefit. This Valdra can own only one marked enemy: a successful new mark replaces her old one, while failure keeps the old mark. It clears on either unit's defeat or wave end. The newly placed mark does not amplify this action or grant its charge reward retroactively.
abilities.mixNote: The mark's party damage bonus is self-contained; Steady Orders adds charge support to later attacks.
summary: Deal 135% ATK damage to one enemy and apply Rally Point for 2 turns.
Allies deal 8% more attack damage to that target. Only 1 enemy can bear Valdra's Rally Point.

abilities.name: Advance Under Cover
abilities.target: All living allies; ally with lowest action gauge
abilities.description: Grant each living ally 15% ATK up and a shield equal to 6% of Valdra's Max HP for two recipient turns. Use the strongest generic ATK-up amount and standard named-shield refresh rules. This skill deals no damage, grants no action gauge and cannot trigger Steady Orders' charge reward.
abilities.mixNote: Standalone party attack and protection; it needs no Rally Point.
summary: Increase all allies' ATK by 15% for 2 turns.
Give them shields equal to 6% of Valdra's Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Crimson Standard
abilities.target: All enemies; one selected primary enemy; all living allies
abilities.description: Deal 130% of Valdra's ATK damage to all enemies. After damage, attempt Rally Point on the selected surviving primary enemy for two target turns. It increases allies' direct action damage to that target by 8%, with the same one-owned-target limit and expiry as Set the Line. A successful new mark replaces the old one; failure leaves the old mark. This Ultimate grants no Crit buff or Steady Orders charge, and its newly placed mark does not boost this action's damage.
abilities.mixNote: Area pressure plus a new focus target; it sets up subsequent allies without requiring Steady Orders.
summary: Deal 130% ATK damage to all enemies.
Apply Rally Point to the main target for 2 turns, increasing allied attack damage to them by 8%. Only 1 enemy can bear Valdra's mark.

abilities.name: Unbowed at the Brink
abilities.target: Self
abilities.description: While alive, Valdra gains 15 percentage points of Crit damage. For each direct Basic, Active or Ultimate action, check her HP after any listed HP cost but before damage. If she is at or below 50% of her Max HP, multiply that action's direct damage by 1.15. Damage over time, counters and follow-ups receive no bonus. The passive performs no healing.
abilities.mixNote: Both bonuses work with imported attacks; only the damage bonus requires low HP.
summary: Increase Valdra's Crit damage by 15%.
Her attacks deal 15% more damage while she is at or below 50% HP.

abilities.name: Sober Point
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 100% of Valdra's ATK damage to one enemy. This attack has no HP cost, healing or bonus Break. Unbowed at the Brink, if selected, checks Valdra's HP immediately before damage.
abilities.mixNote: A cost-free attack when her current HP is dangerous.
summary: Deal 100% ATK damage to one enemy.
This attack costs no HP.

abilities.name: Bloodwritten Lunge
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Pay 6% of Valdra's current HP, rounded down and capped to leave at least one HP, then deal 165% of her ATK damage to one enemy. The HP cost bypasses shields, is not damage and triggers no reaction, charge or resource. At one HP the zero cost does not prevent attacking. Unbowed at the Brink checks HP after the cost. The skill has no DEF ignore or built-in healing.
abilities.mixNote: High direct pressure with an HP cost; no passive is required.
summary: Spend 6% of Valdra's current HP, without dropping her below 1 HP.
Deal 165% ATK damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Redwake Sweep
abilities.target: All enemies; primary auto follows the lowest-HP-percentage rule
abilities.description: Deal 100% of Valdra's ATK damage to each enemy. After all damage, if Valdra is alive, heal her for 10% of the total actual enemy HP damage dealt, capped at 8% of her own Max HP for the entire action. Shield damage and overkill do not contribute. This skill has no HP cost and the passive grants no additional healing.
abilities.mixNote: An area recovery attack; enemy shields reduce the healing it can provide.
summary: Deal 100% ATK damage to all enemies.
Heal Valdra for 10% of the HP damage dealt, up to 8% of her Max HP.

abilities.name: No Step Back
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Pay 12% of Valdra's current HP, rounded down and capped to leave at least one HP, then deal 235% of her ATK damage to one enemy. The cost bypasses shields and triggers no damage reaction, charge or resource. At one HP the zero cost still permits the attack. Unbowed at the Brink checks HP after payment. This skill has no DEF ignore, execute, healing or bonus Break.
abilities.mixNote: A risky direct finisher; the passive can reward the HP threshold reached after payment.
summary: Spend 12% of Valdra's current HP, without dropping her below 1 HP.
Deal 235% ATK damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Heat Behind the Steel
abilities.target: Self; enemies damaged by her direct actions
abilities.description: While alive, Valdra has 10% ATK up, using the strongest generic ATK-up amount. Her direct action attacks ignore 10% of DEF against enemies that had any Burn or her Rosebrand when her action began. Snapshot before applying or consuming a brand. Damage over time, counters and follow-ups do not ignore DEF through this passive. A brand consumed by Lance Through Ash still qualifies for that one action's pre-action snapshot.
abilities.mixNote: The ATK buff works alone. An allied Burn can enable the conditional DEF ignore even without Rosebrand.
summary: Increase Valdra's ATK by 10%.
Her attacks ignore 10% of DEF against enemies already affected by Burn or her Rosebrand.

abilities.name: Kindling Point
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 90% of Valdra's ATK damage, then attempt Rosebrand on the survivor. It ticks for 20% of Valdra's ATK snapshotted on application at the start of each of the target's next two turns. It cannot crit, grant charge or trigger reactions, and a reapplication refreshes to two turns with the stronger tick rather than stacking. A killing blow places no brand.
abilities.mixNote: A self-contained burn source; a quicker direct-damage Basic trades away future burn pressure.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage to one enemy.
Apply Rosebrand, dealing 20% of Valdra's ATK as Burn at the start of their next 2 turns. Refreshes instead of stacking.

abilities.name: Searing Rose Thrust
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Deal 135% of Valdra's ATK damage, then attempt a Rosebrand ticking for 30% of her ATK snapshotted on application at the start of each of the survivor's next two turns. It uses the shared nonstacking Rosebrand rules: refresh to two target turns with the stronger tick, no immediate tick, no Crit, charge or reaction triggers. Existing ticks are not cashed out by reapplication.
abilities.mixNote: A stronger single-target brand source. Its direct portion works even if the brand is resisted.
summary: Deal 135% ATK damage to one enemy.
Apply Rosebrand, dealing 30% of Valdra's ATK as Burn at the start of their next 2 turns. Refreshes instead of stacking.

abilities.name: Field of Embers
abilities.target: All enemies; primary auto follows the lowest-HP-percentage rule
abilities.description: Deal 80% of Valdra's ATK damage to each enemy, then attempt Rosebrand on each survivor in one check per target. Each brand ticks for 20% of Valdra's ATK snapshotted on application at the start of the target's next two turns. Refresh with the stronger tick and two-turn duration rather than stacking. Burn cannot crit, grant charge or trigger reactions. Killing blows place no brand.
abilities.mixNote: Supplies broad delayed damage but no healing, shield or command buff.
summary: Deal 80% ATK damage to all enemies.
Apply Rosebrand to each, dealing 20% of Valdra's ATK as Burn at the start of their next 2 turns. Refreshes instead of stacking.

abilities.name: Lance Through Ash
abilities.target: One enemy; auto chooses lowest HP percentage, then highest action gauge, then lowest formation slot
abilities.description: Before damage, consume this Valdra's Rosebrand on the chosen enemy if one exists. Add the total of its remaining unticked scheduled damage, at most two ticks and capped at 60% of Valdra's current ATK, to a base 180% ATK direct attack. The resulting coefficient is at most 240% of current ATK and is one direct hit; consumed ticks never occur later. With no owned brand, still deal 180% ATK. The passive checks the brand before consumption. Only the resulting direct action hit follows shared Ultimate Break; consuming a brand and its scheduled Burn ticks add none.
abilities.mixNote: Only her owned Rosebrand enables the cash-out; ordinary allied Burn cannot be consumed. Base damage remains without one.
summary: Deal 180% ATK damage to one enemy.
Consume Valdra's Rosebrand to add its remaining Burn damage, up to 60% ATK extra. Consumed Burn will not tick later.

abilities.name: After the Bubble Breaks
abilities.target: Living shielded allies, including Roselle; lowest HP percentage first when more than two qualify
abilities.description: Increase Roselle's Max HP by 12%. When direct enemy damage depletes a temporary HP shield from any hero on a living ally, including Roselle, heal that ally for 4% of Roselle's Max HP after the enemy action resolves. Trigger once per recipient per enemy action and at most twice during each unit's turn. The shared allowance is available at wave entry and resets when any ally or enemy begins a scheduled turn; reactions do not create turns or refresh it. If more than two allies qualify, prioritize lowest remaining HP percentage, then formation slot. Roselle must be alive. Defeated recipients are not healed. Expiry, dispel, DoTs, friendly damage and voluntary shield consumption do not trigger it.
abilities.mixNote: Accepts any hero's HP shields. Two heals are shared across the team in each unit's turn, not two per ally or two per damage component.
summary: Increase Roselle's Max HP by 12%.
When enemy damage breaks an ally's shield, heal that ally for 4% of Roselle's Max HP. Up to twice during each unit's turn.

abilities.name: Droplet Knuckle
abilities.target: One enemy; auto nearest legal enemy; ties use front-to-back formation slot, then roster ID
abilities.description: Deal 90% of Roselle's ATK damage, then give Roselle a shield equal to 4% of Roselle's Max HP for 2 of her turns. A newly created shield cannot enable A Crown Under Pressure on this same action.
abilities.mixNote: Provides a personal HP shield without a resource passive.
summary: Deal 90% ATK damage.
Shield Roselle for 4% of her Max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Shelter One Rose
abilities.target: One living ally; auto lowest current HP percentage; ties use front-to-back formation slot, then roster ID
abilities.description: Give the selected living ally a shield equal to 11% of Roselle's Max HP and 20% DEF for 2 recipient turns. The shield refreshes to the higher remaining/new value; generic DEF buffs use the strongest value rather than adding together.
abilities.mixNote: Focused shield and DEF increase; it does not directly heal.
summary: Shield one ally for 11% of Roselle's Max HP for 2 turns.
Increase that ally's DEF by 20% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Pearl-Lined Canopy
abilities.target: All living allies, including Roselle; remove one debuff from each
abilities.description: Give every living ally a shield equal to 6% of Roselle's Max HP for 2 recipient turns, then remove the oldest removable debuff from each of them. Each ally is checked independently. If an ally has no removable debuff, their shield still applies.
abilities.mixNote: Full-party protection and one cleanse per ally; independent of passive triggers.
summary: Shield all allies for 6% of Roselle's Max HP for 2 turns.
Remove 1 debuff from every ally.

abilities.name: Crown in a Thousand Drops
abilities.target: All living enemies; consume HP shields on Roselle only, then shield Roselle
abilities.description: At cast start snapshot Roselle's current Max HP, including her passive. Consume temporary HP shields currently on Roselle from any hero, up to a total of 70% of that Max HP; preserve excess shielding. Consume layers with the earliest expiry first, then application order. Spend once for the whole cast, never once per enemy. For each enemy hit, deal 125% of Roselle's ATK plus 50% of the shield HP consumed, with the bonus capped at 35% of her snapshotted Max HP before standard DEF, type and critical modifiers. This is direct damage, not true damage. With no shield the base attack still works. Named guard charges such as Frostplate do not count as HP shields. After the attack, shield Roselle for 8% of her Max HP for 2 recipient turns; this new shield cannot fund the same cast. Voluntary consumption never triggers shield-break healing. The shared Ultimate Break budget applies only once per enemy hit. Distinct named shield layers can coexist; the same named shield refreshes to the larger remaining/new value rather than stacking. Existing runtime shields do not currently provide these source layers.
abilities.mixNote: Allied shield providers can fuel this attack. Only shields on Roselle are spent; allies keep their own shields. A 70% Max HP shield pool is needed for the 35% bonus ceiling.
summary: Deal 125% ATK damage to all enemies.
Consume shields on Roselle from any hero. Add 50% of the amount consumed as damage per enemy, capped at 35% of her Max HP.
Then shield Roselle for 8% of her Max HP for 2 turns.
